QuestInfo.name: Stolen Camera
QuestInfo.0: Ritaya said she can't leave the forest yet... for some reason...
QuestInfo.1: Ritaya said that #bSnowFro the Fruitnificent#k took her expensive camera! She asked you to track him down and get it back. He disappear up the rocks to the east, but the guards won't let her go inside.\r\n\r\n#b(Ask #p9000075# the guard about SnowFro the Fruitnificent's whereabouts.)

0.0: When that strange, praying tour-guide girl and I ran into #bSnowFro the Fruitnificent#k, I just knew I had to get a picture, so I chased him down, but SnowFro stole my camera just when I was about to take the shot! I was going to go after him, but #b#p9000075# that guard#k over there wouldn't let me. So, like, can you get my camera back?

yes.0: Do whatever you have to do to get my camera back from #bSnowFro the Fruitnificent#k. Otherwise, I'm not budging.\n\n#i4032603# #b#t4032603

no.0: Like, my camera is worth more than your entire life, and I really want it back.

1.0: Oh! My camera! Yay! I guess I won't get to say goodbye to SnowFro, but oh well. At least I got my camera back.
